blind_spots_patched: The baseline dossier treated India's June 2026 DGTR anti-dumping recommendation on Chinese TPU PPF as an active competitive shield without disclosing that Finance Ministry Customs (ADD) imposition remains unverified as of November 2026, that standalone base TPU film was excluded, or that DGTR documented <25% total domestic volume share and CY24 domestic PPF losses under 200%–300% Chinese undercutting. It also omitted domestic CMVR Rule 100 / Supreme Court automotive window-tint enforcement friction in India.

Baseline Chapter 6 omitted FY2025–26 audit report footnote disclosures on component-auditor reliance for overseas subsidiaries (~36% of consolidated revenue), contingent liabilities and capital commitments (₹215.74 crore including an unprovided ₹18.37 crore disputed tax demand), lease/acceptance obligations (₹28.29 crore), and promoter-director minimum-payout clauses.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: GHFL holds ~60% share in India's young PPF market and is shielded from Chinese TPU price undercutting by DGTR's recommended anti-dumping duty.
